ambient_events: Water finds a seam in the tiling and lets itself down, one drop at a time.
Somewhere off in the dark a broom goes over stone, unhurried, and stops.
The ceiling tiles tick as the trunk behind you breathes.
description: The trunk opens without warning into a hall it was never meant to reach. This was a station concourse once, before the water and the fill and the second city built over the top of it: a barrel of tiled ceiling, a run of ticket windows with the brass grilles still in them, and a floor of black and white stone laid in a pattern that goes on under the silt. Half of it is silt. The other half has been swept, and swept recently, in a hard straight edge that stops where somebody ran out of shift.
name: The Old Concourse
